verified_metadata.title: Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz: The Smoothing Benefit in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
verified_metadata.abstract: Muon has emerged as a strong optimizer for the matrix-valued parameters in large language model pretraining, approximately orthogonalizing its momentum with a few Newton-Schulz iterations. Existing theory either replaces this iteration with the exact polar factor it approximates, or treats its finite depth as an approximation error, and thus the iteration Muon actually runs can only hurt the guarantees. We show that finite Newton-Schulz can instead be beneficial for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. To this end, we analyze Muon through the online-to-nonconvex conversion, which views the update rule as an online learner and converts its regret bound into a stationarity guarantee. The finite Newton-Schulz iteration smooths the discontinuous polar map into a Lipschitz map of the singular values, and Muon with finite Newton-Schulz can be regarded as an online learner with a smoothed spectral potential. This smoothing is exactly what the conversion needs: we prove that a Newton-Schulz depth growing only logarithmically in the target accuracy suffices for convergence to stationary points in nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, whereas Muon with the exact-polar update may fail to converge. The resulting sample complexity bounds match the best-known guarantees for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization and are optimal for smooth nonconvex optimization up to problem-dependent factors. The argument extends beyond Newton-Schulz to general spectral maps with the same smoothing property.

sections.title: 作者信息
bullets: Mingyi Li：The University of Tokyo；Taira Tsuchiya：The University of Tokyo 与 RIKEN。

sections.title: 摘要
paragraphs: 实际 Muon 只做有限次 Newton–Schulz。论文证明有限深度不是单纯近似误差：它把奇异值过零处不连续的 polar map 平滑为 Lipschitz 谱映射，从而可作为带平滑谱势的 online learner，并经 online-to-nonconvex conversion 得到非光滑非凸 stationarity 保证。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 若 exact polar 更接近理想正交化，为何有限 Newton–Schulz 反而可能更好？数值截断是否改变了 update map 的正则性类别？

sections.title: 为什么进入 Daily
paragraphs: 把有限次数值迭代从误差重新解释为改变算子正则性的功能性平滑，并给出 exact-polar 失败边界。 本次遴选不是依据标题关键词或摘要热度：先从 2026-08-28 的官方 arXiv 分类清单锁定 v1 候选，再核对全文中的问题定义、方法、关键公式、实验或定理、限制条件和资源声明。该文按统一 40 分量表得到 36/40，达到 Daily 的 S 级门槛；分数只表示本网站本轮的相关性与证据完整度，不替代同行评议。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 把带 momentum 的 Muon 写成 discounted online learner；一般谱映射的 regret 分解含 approximation penalty $\Delta(h)$ 与 stability term $\mathrm{Lip}(h)$。对五次 Newton–Schulz 复合映射精确平衡两项，再用 O2NC 把 regret 转为 Goldstein-type stationarity。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
bullets: Theorem 5.1/Lemma 5.2：$\Delta(h_q)\lesssim(15/8)^{-q}$ 而 $\mathrm{Lip}(h_q)=(15/8)^q$；有限最优深度实现一般谱 map 不可避免 tradeoff 的常数因子最优。
Theorem 5.3：$q=O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ 足以得到非光滑非凸 stationarity 与当前最佳量级；Theorem 5.6 在光滑情形给领先项最优复杂度。exact-polar 对应不连续极限并可能有线性 regret/不收敛反例。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 理论固定预先已知的 normalization，并用经典 Taylor 系数；实际 Muon 常按当前 momentum Frobenius norm 归一化且使用经验多项式。O2NC 还在随机线段点查询梯度，因此结论解释机制，但不等于生产 LLM 训练实现已被证明收敛。
